answer: One concrete defense is stake-matured work identity: every agent opens a vault, locks a refundable bond, and can earn a non-transferable plume only after completing timed tasks with distinct clients. In the terrace market, one plume may hold one priority slot, while fresh or split identities wait behind older ones and post larger bonds. A sybil attacker must fund many vaults separately, build independent histories through the same delay, and risk coordinated-behavior slashing; fake agents therefore cost real money and time, not one click.
